title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 9.8477e-3 eV²
  λ_q = 0.191992
  m_eff = 2.3273e-1 eV
  T_vev = 1.6014e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.0996 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0100 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.100209 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -2.453e+0
  J_spin = 4.500e-2
